description: budget.vocabulary: the closed sets the forms and the CLI build from (rule 4) — scopes, windows, dimensions, unknown policies, statuses, event kinds and refusal kinds come from the DAEMON, never a client copy. A literal in the client is a second truth that drifts when the set widens; this read is the one place the sets are named, and a new value anywhere else is a bug the CLI's grep test (TestBudgetVocabularyHasNoClientCopy) exists to catch.
